units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|name|237|0
units.english: Heritage Reclaimed
units.italian: Heritage Reclaimed

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|description|238|0
units.english: Use your newly acquired Anomalocaris to bring aid to the Unfettered Hai on <planet> by <date>.
units.italian: Usa l'Anomalocaris appena acquisito per portare aiuto agli Hai Unfettered su <planet> entro il <date>.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|You leave the shipyard and go to the spaceport after your encounter. A worker immediately greets you while others begin to fill your ship with crates, and a quick check of the shipment data shows that the cargo has already been allocated in your name. All that's left is to deliver it to <destination> by <date>.|254|0
units.english: You leave the shipyard and go to the spaceport after your encounter. A worker immediately greets you while others begin to fill your ship with crates, and a quick check of the shipment data shows that the cargo has already been allocated in your name. All that's left is to deliver it to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Lasci il cantiere e vai allo spazioporto dopo il tuo incontro. Un lavoratore ti accoglie subito mentre altri cominciano a riempire la tua nave di casse, e un rapido controllo dei dati della spedizione mostra che il carico è già stato assegnato a tuo nome. Non resta che consegnarlo su <destination> entro il <date>.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|	As you head to back to your ship and prepare to take off from the planet, you notice a message on the command panel:|255|0
units.english: As you head to back to your ship and prepare to take off from the planet, you notice a message on the command panel:
units.italian: Mentre torni alla tua nave e ti prepari a decollare dal pianeta, noti un messaggio sul pannello di comando:

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|	"You would be wise to bring the Anomalocaris we trusted you with for your delivery."|256|0
units.english: "You would be wise to bring the Anomalocaris we trusted you with for your delivery."
units.italian: "Faresti bene a portare con te l'Anomalocaris che ti abbiamo affidato, per la tua consegna."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|As you enter the system, you prepare for a fight to get the cargo through. However, the usually aggressive Unfettered have suddenly stopped firing at you.|265|0
units.english: As you enter the system, you prepare for a fight to get the cargo through. However, the usually aggressive Unfettered have suddenly stopped firing at you.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema ti prepari a combattere per far passare il carico. Però gli Unfettered, di solito aggressivi, hanno smesso all'improvviso di spararti.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|dialog|268|0
units.english: The Unfettered and their associates are clearly not happy when they somehow find out you didn't deliver the cargo in time, leaving you a brief message on your command panel: "You will not prove yourself to us by failing our requests."
units.italian: Gli Unfettered e i loro associati non sono certo contenti quando in qualche modo scoprono che non hai consegnato il carico in tempo, e ti lasciano un breve messaggio sul pannello di comando: "Non ti dimostrerai degno di noi fallendo le nostre richieste."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|dialog|270|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you either did not bring the Anomalocaris, or some of the cargo was on another ship.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma o non hai portato l'Anomalocaris, o parte del carico era su un'altra nave.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|dialog|274|0
units.english: After landing, a group of Unfettered gather around your ship and begin unloading the medical supplies, though strangely they don't seem to be in any hurry. Shortly after they've finished, you receive a rather brief message from the Hai you bought the ship from, along with an unusually large sum of credits. "Thank you for helping our brethren, <last>. Please accept these <payment>."
units.italian: Dopo l'atterraggio, un gruppo di Unfettered si raduna attorno alla tua nave e comincia a scaricare le forniture mediche, anche se stranamente non sembrano avere fretta. Poco dopo aver finito, ricevi un messaggio piuttosto breve dall'Hai a cui hai comprato la nave, insieme a una somma di crediti insolitamente grande. "Grazie per aver aiutato i nostri fratelli, <last>. Accetta questi <payment>."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 2|log|276|0
units.english: Delivered a pressing food shipment to the Unfettered Hai using the Anomalocaris, which seems to have pleased them.
units.italian: Consegnato un carico urgente di cibo agli Hai Unfettered usando l'Anomalocaris, cosa che sembra averli soddisfatti.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|name|283|0
units.english: Ancient Claim
units.italian: Ancient Claim

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|description|284|0
units.english: Defeat the Unfettered challenger in combat in the system of <system>. You only have 2 days, and becoming disabled will result in losing the fight.
units.italian: Sconfiggi in combattimento lo sfidante Unfettered nel sistema <system>. Hai solo 2 giorni, e restare fuori uso significa perdere lo scontro.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|After delivering the supplies, you realize your ship is the center of attention. One Unfettered that looks like an engineer comes to speak to you, initially warmer than usual compared to your previous experiences with other Unfettered.|292|0
units.english: After delivering the supplies, you realize your ship is the center of attention. One Unfettered that looks like an engineer comes to speak to you, initially warmer than usual compared to your previous experiences with other Unfettered.
units.italian: Dopo aver consegnato le forniture, ti accorgi che la tua nave è al centro dell'attenzione. Un Unfettered che sembra un ingegnere viene a parlarti, inizialmente più cordiale del solito rispetto alle tue esperienze precedenti con altri Unfettered.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"Welcome. Although I do not know how you have obtained this ship, I imagine some of us will see it as a sign. You see, it is a relic of our past, a past we are quite proud of. As such, most Unfettered warriors will say that you need to prove your right to use it."|293|0
units.english: "Welcome. Although I do not know how you have obtained this ship, I imagine some of us will see it as a sign. You see, it is a relic of our past, a past we are quite proud of. As such, most Unfettered warriors will say that you need to prove your right to use it."
units.italian: "Benvenuto. Anche se non so come tu abbia ottenuto questa nave, immagino che alcuni di noi lo vedranno come un segno. Vedi, è un relitto del nostro passato, un passato di cui siamo piuttosto orgogliosi. Per questo la maggior parte dei guerrieri Unfettered dirà che devi dimostrare il tuo diritto a usarla."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	After a sigh, her tone then changes. "But I don't believe in any of that. What does matter to me is that ship is both durable and filled with valuable ancient technology."|294|0
units.english: After a sigh, her tone then changes. "But I don't believe in any of that. What does matter to me is that ship is both durable and filled with valuable ancient technology."
units.italian: Dopo un sospiro, il suo tono cambia. "Ma io non credo a nulla di tutto questo. Quello che per me conta è che quella nave è sia resistente sia piena di preziosa tecnologia antica."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	Her eyes light up as she focuses more on your ship. "I even see weapons that we fought valiantly to obtain from the savage Korath!"|295|0
units.english: Her eyes light up as she focuses more on your ship. "I even see weapons that we fought valiantly to obtain from the savage Korath!"
units.italian: I suoi occhi si illuminano mentre si concentra di più sulla tua nave. "Vedo persino armi che abbiamo combattuto con valore per ottenere dai selvaggi Korath!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	All of a sudden, she raises her voice for everyone to hear. "I, Mera, challenge you! It will be a one-on-one duel; you in the Anomalocaris against my own champion. The winner will earn the right to own this honorable relic and its mighty weapons!"|298|0
units.english: All of a sudden, she raises her voice for everyone to hear. "I, Mera, challenge you! It will be a one-on-one duel; you in the Anomalocaris against my own champion. The winner will earn the right to own this honorable relic and its mighty weapons!"
units.italian: All'improvviso alza la voce perché tutti la sentano. "Io, Mera, ti sfido! Sarà un duello uno contro uno: tu sull'Anomalocaris contro il mio campione. Il vincitore si guadagnerà il diritto di possedere questo onorevole relitto e le sue possenti armi!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"What do I get if I win?"|300|0
units.english: "What do I get if I win?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ottengo se vinco?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"Can't I just sell it to you?"|302|0
units.english: "Can't I just sell it to you?"
units.italian: "Non posso semplicemente vendertela?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"I bought this ship. It's mine and I shall do what I please with it."|303|0
units.english: "I bought this ship. It's mine and I shall do what I please with it."
units.italian: "Ho comprato questa nave. È mia, e ne faccio ciò che voglio."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"No, because in the eyes of my brethren that would mean I, too, did not deserve this ship. They would then challenge me for it."|305|0
units.english: "No, because in the eyes of my brethren that would mean I, too, did not deserve this ship. They would then challenge me for it."
units.italian: "No, perché agli occhi dei miei fratelli questo significherebbe che nemmeno io meritavo questa nave. E allora la sfiderebbero a me."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	Mera turns around, talking to other Unfettered for a bit before addressing you again. "You will win the right to access our worlds. But, in order to keep our respect, you must keep this Anomalocaris in good condition until you prove yourself another way. It is a priceless artifact. Should you refuse to prove your worth, you will no longer be allowed to land here."|307|0
units.english: Mera turns around, talking to other Unfettered for a bit before addressing you again. "You will win the right to access our worlds. But, in order to keep our respect, you must keep this Anomalocaris in good condition until you prove yourself another way. It is a priceless artifact. Should you refuse to prove your worth, you will no longer be allowed to land here."
units.italian: Mera si volta, parla un po' con altri Unfettered e poi si rivolge di nuovo a te. "Ti guadagnerai il diritto di accedere ai nostri mondi. Ma, per mantenere il nostro rispetto, devi tenere questo Anomalocaris in buone condizioni finché non ti dimostrerai in un altro modo. È un artefatto inestimabile. Se rifiuti di dimostrare il tuo valore, non ti sarà più permesso atterrare qui."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	She then glares at you. "Beware, for although there are no official rules, you must use only the Anomalocaris. So, will you take to the skies, or are you too afraid?"|308|0
units.english: She then glares at you. "Beware, for although there are no official rules, you must use only the Anomalocaris. So, will you take to the skies, or are you too afraid?"
units.italian: Poi ti lancia un'occhiataccia. "Attento: anche se non ci sono regole ufficiali, devi usare solo l'Anomalocaris. Allora, ti alzerai in volo, o hai troppa paura?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"I accept."|310|0
units.english: "I accept."
units.italian: "Accetto."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"I have nothing to prove to you. This is my ship now."|311|0
units.english: "I have nothing to prove to you. This is my ship now."
units.italian: "Non ho nulla da dimostrarti. Questa nave ora è mia."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	Mera grins. "Good! I won't be fighting you personally, as it is too risky to do so. I am but an engineer, after all. I would also not want to deny my brother and his crew the opportunity to prove themselves against a powerful human warrior!"|313|0
units.english: Mera grins. "Good! I won't be fighting you personally, as it is too risky to do so. I am but an engineer, after all. I would also not want to deny my brother and his crew the opportunity to prove themselves against a powerful human warrior!"
units.italian: Mera sogghigna. "Bene! Non ti combatterò di persona, è troppo rischioso. Dopo tutto sono solo un'ingegnere. E non vorrei nemmeno negare a mio fratello e al suo equipaggio l'occasione di dimostrarsi contro un potente guerriero umano!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	You're not sure if Mera is being serious or not, but her friends seem to be in for it. One that appears to be their leader approaches you. "So you think you deserve to fly this mighty ship of the Hai empire?"|314|0
units.english: You're not sure if Mera is being serious or not, but her friends seem to be in for it. One that appears to be their leader approaches you. "So you think you deserve to fly this mighty ship of the Hai empire?"
units.italian: Non sei sicuro che Mera faccia sul serio, ma i suoi amici sembrano decisi. Uno che pare il loro capo ti si avvicina. "Dunque pensi di meritare di pilotare questa possente nave dell'impero Hai?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"Yeah, what makes you think that, human?" another one adds.|315|0
units.english: "Yeah, what makes you think that, human?" another one adds.
units.italian: "Sì, e cosa te lo fa pensare, umano?", aggiunge un altro.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	(Say nothing.)|317|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"Are you trying to scare me out of the fight?"|318|0
units.english: "Are you trying to scare me out of the fight?"
units.italian: "Stai cercando di spaventarmi per farmi rinunciare allo scontro?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"I guess we'll find out," says a third.|320|0
units.english: "I guess we'll find out," says a third.
units.italian: "Lo scopriremo", dice un terzo.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	The leader of the group gets closer and addresses you in a more serious tone. "You should be aware that this is not so much a friendly competition as it is a fight for you to truly earn the right to fly this ship. You should know that this fight has a few... implicit rules, even if there are no official ones. We would assume everyone knows them, but since you are an outsider I will explain them to you," he says as he leads you away from the group.|322|0
units.english: The leader of the group gets closer and addresses you in a more serious tone. "You should be aware that this is not so much a friendly competition as it is a fight for you to truly earn the right to fly this ship. You should know that this fight has a few... implicit rules, even if there are no official ones. We would assume everyone knows them, but since you are an outsider I will explain them to you," he says as he leads you away from the group.
units.italian: Il capo del gruppo si avvicina e ti parla con tono più serio. "Sappi che questa non è tanto una competizione amichevole quanto uno scontro per guadagnarti davvero il diritto di pilotare questa nave. Devi sapere che questo scontro ha alcune... regole implicite, anche se non ce ne sono di ufficiali. Diamo per scontato che tutti le conoscano, ma dato che sei un esterno te le spiegherò", dice mentre ti allontana dal gruppo.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"Naturally, because this is a duel, nobody other than us may interfere, but you should also know that being disabled counts as a loss. Don't even think about tricking us by switching to something other than this Anomalocaris, or we will not bother showing up! You must prove you deserve it, after all. To the victor go the spoils, so looting is allowed, but do not attempt to steal our ships. Do so, and all the Unfettered will be against you!"|323|0
units.english: "Naturally, because this is a duel, nobody other than us may interfere, but you should also know that being disabled counts as a loss. Don't even think about tricking us by switching to something other than this Anomalocaris, or we will not bother showing up! You must prove you deserve it, after all. To the victor go the spoils, so looting is allowed, but do not attempt to steal our ships. Do so, and all the Unfettered will be against you!"
units.italian: "Naturalmente, dato che è un duello, nessuno oltre a noi può interferire, ma devi anche sapere che restare fuori uso conta come sconfitta. Non pensare nemmeno di ingannarci passando a qualcosa che non sia questo Anomalocaris, o non ci prenderemo la briga di presentarci! Devi dimostrare di meritartela, dopo tutto. Al vincitore vanno le spoglie, quindi il saccheggio è permesso, ma non tentare di rubare le nostre navi. Se lo fai, tutti gli Unfettered saranno contro di te!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	He then looks at you intensely, straight in the eyes. "We sometimes bend the rules for our friends, but that is not the case with you."|325|0
units.english: He then looks at you intensely, straight in the eyes. "We sometimes bend the rules for our friends, but that is not the case with you."
units.italian: Poi ti guarda intensamente, dritto negli occhi. "A volte pieghiamo le regole per i nostri amici, ma con te non è questo il caso."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	Mera starts to look a bit impatient. "Are you going to talk all day, or are you going to fight? Head to Ehma Ti already!" The Unfettered immediately head to their ships, but Mera pulls you in close once they are far enough away. "I want this done by the end of the day, so do not try my patience. You are lucky I offered this deal in the first place, as they were planning to take the relic by force. Now, quick, get to your ship! Make any last minute modifications you may need, and then come fight us."|328|0
units.english: Mera starts to look a bit impatient. "Are you going to talk all day, or are you going to fight? Head to Ehma Ti already!" The Unfettered immediately head to their ships, but Mera pulls you in close once they are far enough away. "I want this done by the end of the day, so do not try my patience. You are lucky I offered this deal in the first place, as they were planning to take the relic by force. Now, quick, get to your ship! Make any last minute modifications you may need, and then come fight us."
units.italian: Mera comincia a sembrare un po' impaziente. "Vuoi parlare tutto il giorno, o combattere? Vai a Ehma Ti, insomma!" Gli Unfettered si dirigono subito alle loro navi, ma Mera ti tira da parte quando sono abbastanza lontani. "Voglio che sia fatto entro la fine della giornata, quindi non mettere alla prova la mia pazienza. Sei fortunato che abbia offerto io questo accordo, perché avevano intenzione di prendersi il relitto con la forza. Ora, svelto, vai alla tua nave! Fai le ultime modifiche che ti servono, poi vieni a combattere contro di noi."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	You see the Unfettered have already begun their launching procedures, so you should prepare for takeoff in your Anomalocaris, and no other ships, as soon as you can.|329|0
units.english: You see the Unfettered have already begun their launching procedures, so you should prepare for takeoff in your Anomalocaris, and no other ships, as soon as you can.
units.italian: Vedi che gli Unfettered hanno già cominciato le procedure di lancio, quindi dovresti prepararti a decollare con il tuo Anomalocaris, e con nessun'altra nave, il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	Seeing as they are unlikely to cooperate, you quickly head to your ship and launch, with the Unfettered rushing after you.|335|0
units.english: Seeing as they are unlikely to cooperate, you quickly head to your ship and launch, with the Unfettered rushing after you.
units.italian: Visto che è improbabile che collaborino, ti precipiti alla tua nave e decolli, con gli Unfettered che ti corrono dietro.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|As you leave the planet's atmosphere, you receive a short message. "We are waiting for you in Ehma Ti today. Do not disappoint us."|345|0
units.english: As you leave the planet's atmosphere, you receive a short message. "We are waiting for you in Ehma Ti today. Do not disappoint us."
units.italian: Mentre lasci l'atmosfera del pianeta, ricevi un breve messaggio. "Ti aspettiamo a Ehma Ti oggi. Non deluderci."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|The Unfettered don't seem too pleased to see you leaving with their prize. The challenger is already waiting for you in orbit, and hails you. "Where do you think you're going, monkey?"|350|0
units.english: The Unfettered don't seem too pleased to see you leaving with their prize. The challenger is already waiting for you in orbit, and hails you. "Where do you think you're going, monkey?"
units.italian: Gli Unfettered non sembrano troppo contenti di vederti andare via con il loro premio. Lo sfidante ti aspetta già in orbita e ti chiama. "Dove credi di andare, scimmia?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|label|352|0
units.english: too many ships
units.italian: too many ships

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|As you take off to join your fleet in orbit, you receive a hail from the Unfettered. "You must leave your fleet on hold here. If they help you, the duel will be forfeit!"|353|0
units.english: As you take off to join your fleet in orbit, you receive a hail from the Unfettered. "You must leave your fleet on hold here. If they help you, the duel will be forfeit!"
units.italian: Mentre decolli per unirti alla tua flotta in orbita, ricevi una chiamata dagli Unfettered. "Devi lasciare la tua flotta in attesa qui. Se ti aiutano, il duello sarà annullato!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|You are hailed by the Unfettered as soon as you reach orbit. "You think us blind, monkey? You are not flying the relic as your flagship! You're not even worth a launch sequence; the duel is forfeit," they say angrily.|356|0
units.english: You are hailed by the Unfettered as soon as you reach orbit. "You think us blind, monkey? You are not flying the relic as your flagship! You're not even worth a launch sequence; the duel is forfeit," they say angrily.
units.italian: Sei chiamato dagli Unfettered appena raggiungi l'orbita. "Ci credi ciechi, scimmia? Non stai pilotando il relitto come nave ammiraglia! Non vali nemmeno una sequenza di lancio; il duello è annullato", dicono arrabbiati.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|As you enter the system you can see your challenger is indeed waiting for you, and they promptly send you a hail. "Show us what you've got, monkey! Show us that you control your weapons well, as any warrior should! Prove to us that you have the strength to disable our ships, yet still have the restraint not to destroy them!"|366|0
units.english: As you enter the system you can see your challenger is indeed waiting for you, and they promptly send you a hail. "Show us what you've got, monkey! Show us that you control your weapons well, as any warrior should! Prove to us that you have the strength to disable our ships, yet still have the restraint not to destroy them!"
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema vedi che lo sfidante ti aspetta davvero, e ti manda subito un segnale. "Mostraci di che cosa sei capace, scimmia! Mostraci che sai controllare bene le tue armi, come ogni guerriero dovrebbe! Dimostraci di avere la forza di mettere fuori uso le nostre navi, ma anche la moderazione di non distruggerle!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|label|368|0
units.english: too many ships
units.italian: too many ships

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|As you arrive with your fleet in this system, you receive a hail from the Unfettered. "If you can't even count how many ships you have, you're not worthy of our time, monkey! Dishonor will get you nowhere with us True Hai! Leave."|369|0
units.english: As you arrive with your fleet in this system, you receive a hail from the Unfettered. "If you can't even count how many ships you have, you're not worthy of our time, monkey! Dishonor will get you nowhere with us True Hai! Leave."
units.italian: Arrivando con la tua flotta in questo sistema, ricevi una chiamata dagli Unfettered. "Se non sai nemmeno contare quante navi hai, non sei degno del nostro tempo, scimmia! Il disonore non ti porterà da nessuna parte con noi, i Veri Hai! Vattene."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|You are hailed by the Unfettered as you enter the system. "Monkey! Why do you refuse to use the relic? Only by winning with the relic can you prove yourself worthy of it. Leave - we will not waste any more of our time with the likes of you."|372|0
units.english: You are hailed by the Unfettered as you enter the system. "Monkey! Why do you refuse to use the relic? Only by winning with the relic can you prove yourself worthy of it. Leave - we will not waste any more of our time with the likes of you."
units.italian: Sei chiamato dagli Unfettered mentre entri nel sistema. "Scimmia! Perché rifiuti di usare il relitto? Solo vincendo con il relitto puoi dimostrare di esserne degno. Vattene: non sprecheremo altro tempo con gente come te."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|dialog|380|0
units.english: You receive a hail from the Unfettered. "You ran away and failed to complete the duel. As such, you will not enjoy unwarranted respect any longer! It would be in your best interest to return the ship to us should we ever find you on our worlds again!
units.italian: Ricevi una chiamata dagli Unfettered. "Sei fuggito e non hai completato il duello. Perciò non godrai più di un rispetto immeritato! Ti converrebbe restituirci la nave, se mai ti trovassimo di nuovo sui nostri mondi!

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|After your ship is disabled, one of the Unfettered ships hails you. "You have lost the challenge, but we didn't expect much from a human like you. We will repair your ship for a fair bribe, but you better land at one of our worlds and return it to us with a most generous compensation. If you try to keep it from us, we'll do things the hard way.|384|0
units.english: After your ship is disabled, one of the Unfettered ships hails you. "You have lost the challenge, but we didn't expect much from a human like you. We will repair your ship for a fair bribe, but you better land at one of our worlds and return it to us with a most generous compensation. If you try to keep it from us, we'll do things the hard way.
units.italian: Dopo che la tua nave è fuori uso, una delle navi Unfettered ti chiama. "Hai perso la sfida, ma non ci aspettavamo molto da un umano come te. Ripareremo la tua nave per una congrua tangente, ma faresti meglio ad atterrare su uno dei nostri mondi e restituircela con un risarcimento molto generoso. Se proverai a tenerla, faremo le cose in modo duro.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"Be warned, however, that your truce with us ends as soon as you land. Today, you've failed us. Maybe someday you will prove yourself otherwise."|385|0
units.english: "Be warned, however, that your truce with us ends as soon as you land. Today, you've failed us. Maybe someday you will prove yourself otherwise."
units.italian: "Sappi però che la tua tregua con noi finisce appena atterri. Oggi ci hai deluso. Forse un giorno ti dimostrerai diverso."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|dialog|391|0
units.english: You are contacted by the Unfettered as you enter the planet's atmosphere. "You failed to complete the duel. The ceasefire is over. You will not enjoy unwarranted respect any longer!"
units.italian: Sei contattato dagli Unfettered mentre entri nell'atmosfera del pianeta. "Non hai completato il duello. Il cessate il fuoco è finito. Non godrai più di un rispetto immeritato!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|dialog|402|0
units.english: You receive a hail from Mera, who sounds quite angry. "Destroying the ship can only be due to either incompetence or evil intent, and we will not tolerate either!"
units.italian: Ricevi una chiamata da Mera, che sembra piuttosto arrabbiata. "Distruggere la nave può essere solo frutto di incompetenza o di intenti malvagi, e non tollereremo né l'una né gli altri!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|You receive a message from the Unfettered ship. "We surrender. Land on Firelode to receive your reward."|408|0
units.english: You receive a message from the Unfettered ship. "We surrender. Land on Firelode to receive your reward."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio dalla nave Unfettered. "Ci arrendiamo. Atterra su Firelode per ricevere la tua ricompensa."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|"You come here with a fleet and have the audacity to disable my ship? Your dishonor knows no bound, monkey!"|411|0
units.english: "You come here with a fleet and have the audacity to disable my ship? Your dishonor knows no bound, monkey!"
units.italian: "Vieni qui con una flotta e hai la sfacciataggine di mettere fuori uso la mia nave? Il tuo disonore non conosce limiti, scimmia!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|dialog|424|0
units.english: You receive a hail from Mera, who sounds quite angry. "Destroying the ship can only be due to either incompetence or evil intent, and we will not tolerate either!"
units.italian: Ricevi una chiamata da Mera, che sembra piuttosto arrabbiata. "Distruggere la nave può essere solo frutto di incompetenza o di intenti malvagi, e non tollereremo né l'una né gli altri!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|You have managed to defeat the Unfettered challenger. Now it's time to land on Firelode and claim your reward.|430|0
units.english: You have managed to defeat the Unfettered challenger. Now it's time to land on Firelode and claim your reward.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a sconfiggere lo sfidante Unfettered. Ora è il momento di atterrare su Firelode e reclamare la tua ricompensa.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|"You come here with a fleet and have the audacity to disable my ship? Your dishonor knows no bound, monkey!"|433|0
units.english: "You come here with a fleet and have the audacity to disable my ship? Your dishonor knows no bound, monkey!"
units.italian: "Vieni qui con una flotta e hai la sfacciataggine di mettere fuori uso la mia nave? Il tuo disonore non conosce limiti, scimmia!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|dialog|444|0
units.english: Mera hails you. "Stop! I am only here as an observer. If you destroy my ship, the deal is off!"
units.italian: Mera ti chiama. "Fermati! Sono qui solo come osservatrice. Se distruggi la mia nave, l'accordo salta!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|dialog|448|0
units.english: As you destroy the Lightning Bug, along with Mera and her crew in it, you receive an angry hail from the Unfettered. "You completely disrespected the rules of a duel and killed one of our most prominent engineers! You will not be welcome here anymore!"
units.italian: Mentre distruggi la Lightning Bug, con Mera e il suo equipaggio a bordo, ricevi una chiamata arrabbiata dagli Unfettered. "Hai completamente mancato di rispetto alle regole di un duello e hai ucciso una delle nostre ingegnere più illustri! Non sarai più il benvenuto qui!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|log|462|0
units.english: Managed to use an ancient Hai warship to beat an Unfettered challenger, earning respect with the Unfettered Hai so long as the ship remains in my possession.
units.italian: Riuscito a usare un'antica nave da guerra Hai per battere uno sfidante Unfettered, guadagnando il rispetto degli Hai Unfettered finché la nave resterà in mio possesso.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|When you land in one piece, Mera approaches, looking quite surprised. "You really won! I saw everything, and the data I got on the effects of these exotic weapons will be quite useful for my research. Was it hard for you?"|464|0
units.english: When you land in one piece, Mera approaches, looking quite surprised. "You really won! I saw everything, and the data I got on the effects of these exotic weapons will be quite useful for my research. Was it hard for you?"
units.italian: Quando atterri tutto intero, Mera si avvicina, sembrando molto sorpresa. "Hai vinto davvero! Ho visto tutto, e i dati che ho raccolto sugli effetti di queste armi esotiche saranno molto utili per la mia ricerca. È stato difficile per te?"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"It was fun."|466|0
units.english: "It was fun."
units.italian: "È stato divertente."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"This was easy!"|468|0
units.english: "This was easy!"
units.italian: "È stato facile!"

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"It was a challenge."|469|0
units.english: "It was a challenge."
units.italian: "È stata una sfida."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"Don't get overconfident, Captain," she muses. "I am sure you know what happens to such pilots.|471|0
units.english: "Don't get overconfident, Captain," she muses. "I am sure you know what happens to such pilots.
units.italian: "Non diventare troppo sicuro di te, capitano", riflette. "Sono sicura che sai cosa succede a certi piloti.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"Oh, so their plan almost worked after all? Maybe I should have participated in the fight too.|474|0
units.english: "Oh, so their plan almost worked after all? Maybe I should have participated in the fight too.
units.italian: "Oh, quindi il loro piano ha quasi funzionato dopotutto? Forse avrei dovuto partecipare anch'io allo scontro.

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	"Well, congratulations, I did not think you had it in you. I will give you authorization to land, on the condition that you keep this relic from our past in one piece. Remember, right now, your reputation with us is solely due to that ship. If you somehow lose it because of incompetence on your own end, it would look pretty bad to the True Hai."|476|0
units.english: "Well, congratulations, I did not think you had it in you. I will give you authorization to land, on the condition that you keep this relic from our past in one piece. Remember, right now, your reputation with us is solely due to that ship. If you somehow lose it because of incompetence on your own end, it would look pretty bad to the True Hai."
units.italian: "Beh, congratulazioni, non pensavo che ne avessi la stoffa. Ti darò l'autorizzazione ad atterrare, a condizione che tu tenga intero questo relitto del nostro passato. Ricorda: al momento la tua reputazione con noi dipende unicamente da quella nave. Se in qualche modo la perdi per un'incompetenza tua, farai una pessima figura con i Veri Hai."

units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|	Mera then walks off as she begins reviewing data from your fight on a small device. For now, it seems that the Unfettered Hai have some level of respect for you, so long as you have the Anomalocaris.|477|0
units.english: Mera then walks off as she begins reviewing data from your fight on a small device. For now, it seems that the Unfettered Hai have some level of respect for you, so long as you have the Anomalocaris.
units.italian: Mera poi se ne va mentre comincia a rivedere i dati del tuo scontro su un piccolo dispositivo. Per ora sembra che gli Hai Unfettered abbiano un certo rispetto per te, finché hai l'Anomalocaris.
